export function parseSquareColor(input: string) {
  const value = input.trim().toLowerCase();

  if (hexColorPattern.test(value)) {
    return value;
  }

  if (supportedNamedColors.has(value)) {
    return value;
  }

  return undefined;
}

FROM node:22-bookworm-slim

ENV DISPLAY=:99
ENV PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/ms-playwright

RUN apt-get update \
  && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates \
    dumb-init \
    ffmpeg \
    fonts-liberation \
    gzip \
    libasound2 \
    libasound2-plugins \
    libatk-bridge2.0-0 \
    libgbm1 \
    libgtk-3-0 \
    libnss3 \
    libx11-xcb1 \
    libxcomposite1 \
    libxdamage1 \
    libxrandr2 \
    pulseaudio \
    pulseaudio-utils \
    tar \
    xvfb \
  && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /workspace

RUN corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.12.1 --activate

COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json ./
COPY apps/sample-game/package.json apps/sample-game/package.json
COPY packages/game-kit/package.json packages/game-kit/package.json
COPY packages/game-dev/package.json packages/game-dev/package.json
COPY packages/protocol/package.json packages/protocol/package.json
COPY services/stream-runtime/package.json services/stream-runtime/package.json

RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

# Cache the browser independently from game/SDK source edits.
RUN pnpm --filter stream-runtime exec playwright install chromium

RUN useradd --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin runtime \
  && mkdir -p /tmp/.X11-unix /home/runtime/.cache/node \
  && chmod 1777 /tmp/.X11-unix \
  && cp -a /root/.cache/node/corepack /home/runtime/.cache/node/corepack \
  && chown -R runtime:runtime /workspace /ms-playwright /home/runtime/.cache

COPY --chown=runtime:runtime apps/sample-game apps/sample-game
COPY --chown=runtime:runtime packages/game-kit packages/game-kit
COPY --chown=runtime:runtime packages/game-dev packages/game-dev
COPY --chown=runtime:runtime packages/protocol packages/protocol
COPY --chown=runtime:runtime services/stream-runtime services/stream-runtime

USER runtime
ENV HOME=/home/runtime

RUN pnpm --filter @repo/protocol build \
  && pnpm --filter @repo/game-kit build \
  && pnpm --filter @repo/game-dev build \
  && pnpm --filter stream-runtime build \
  && pnpm --filter sample-game build

# The bundled game starts through Corepack under this user, including offline.
RUN COREPACK_ENABLE_NETWORK=0 corepack pnpm --version

ENTRYPOINT ["dumb-init", "--"]
CMD ["node", "services/stream-runtime/dist/index.js"]
